release_name: v1.1.2 - Security Sweep (urllib3, werkzeug, PyJWT) & Dependency Updates
features: Security sweep: urllib3 2.8.0 (CVE-2026-97687/97688/97689), werkzeug 3.1.9 (CVE-2026-102598), PyJWT 2.15.1 (CVE-2026-101918/102275); also zeroconf, websockets, black 26.5.1

Universal search now shows a warning when YouTube fails (quota exhausted, missing key) instead of an empty "No results found"; the search box searches on Enter instead of per keystroke to conserve YouTube API quota (#548)
YouTube quota tracking: once Google reports the daily quota exceeded, all YouTube calls stop until the Pacific-time reset; previously-untracked callers now feed the tracker (#549)
Universal search searches exactly what was typed, matching across artist and title (#545)
Dependency sweep, including bgutil PO-token server 2.0.0 (RCE fix)
IMVDb integration removed entirely (client, settings, UI, docs) - its search API was permanently broken on IMVDb's own infrastructure (#520-522)
Official-video discovery now powered by MusicBrainz's curated music-video relationship data - no API key required (#523)

Several real bugs found and fixed along the way: a permanently-deflated data-quality/coverage score, a save handler that silently wiped historical imvdb_id data, and a broken CLI script that crashed on every invocation
Advanced Artist Management with multi-criteria search and bulk operations
Comprehensive Video Discovery with dual-source integration (MusicBrainz + YouTube)
Professional Thumbnail Management with multi-source search and cropping
Intelligent Organization with automatic folder creation and cleanup
Advanced Search System with real-time suggestions and filtering
Bulk Operations with multi-select editing and batch processing
Video Streaming with built-in player and transcoding
System Health monitoring with comprehensive diagnostics
Database-Driven Settings with complete configuration management
Download Management with queue visualization and progress tracking
Multi-User Authentication with role-based access control
Advanced Security with password policies and audit logging
Modern UI with left sidebar navigation and theme system
MvTV Continuous Player with cinematic mode
Two-Factor Authentication with TOTP support
Fixed Video Search Results Display with improved CSS and field mapping
Robust CI/CD Integration with comprehensive testing and deployment
Enhanced Database Initialization with secure admin user creation
